_note: Single source of truth for roles, business services, value constructs and skills. The admin portal writes to this file. Skill ids are shared across value constructs on purpose - that overlap is what lets a rating in one place carry evidence into another.

roles.name: Backend Development
roles.tagline: Build the engine rooms - the APIs, data and systems that everything else runs on.
roles.description: Backend developers build what users never see but always feel: the APIs an app calls, the database holding its truth, the login that keeps it safe, and the machinery that keeps it fast when a thousand people show up at once.

business_services.name: API Development & Management
business_services.tagline: Design, build, document and tune the interfaces other systems talk to.

value_constructs.name: Design REST APIs
value_constructs.description: Decide what the endpoints are, what they return, and how they behave before a line of code is written.

value_constructs.name: Build API Endpoints
value_constructs.description: Turn the design into working, deployed endpoints in a real backend framework.

value_constructs.name: Create API Documentation
value_constructs.description: Write the spec another developer can build against without asking you a single question.

value_constructs.name: Test APIs
value_constructs.description: Prove the endpoints work - and keep proving it automatically as the code changes.

value_constructs.name: Optimize API Performance
value_constructs.description: Make slow endpoints fast, and decide which slowness is worth fixing first.

business_services.name: Database Design & Management
business_services.tagline: Model the data, relate it, query it, speed it up and keep it safe.

value_constructs.name: Design Database Schema
value_constructs.description: Turn a messy real-world problem into tables and columns that will still make sense a year later.

value_constructs.name: Build Database Relationships
value_constructs.description: Connect entities correctly so the data cannot drift out of sync with itself.

value_constructs.name: Write Database Queries
value_constructs.description: Get exactly the data you need out, correctly, whether by raw SQL or an ORM.

value_constructs.name: Optimize Database Performance
value_constructs.description: Find the query that is quietly taking three seconds, and make it take thirty milliseconds.

value_constructs.name: Create Backup & Recovery Systems
value_constructs.description: Make sure that when something goes badly wrong, the data comes back.

business_services.name: Authentication & User Management
business_services.tagline: Own who gets in, what they can touch, and how their session stays safe.

value_constructs.name: Build Signup/Login Systems
value_constructs.description: Build the front door: registration, login, and passwords stored so they can never be read back.

value_constructs.name: Implement Role-Based Access
value_constructs.description: Define who is allowed to do what, and enforce it in one place rather than fifty.

value_constructs.name: Implement Token Authentication
value_constructs.description: Issue, verify and expire tokens so services can trust a request without re-asking for a password.

value_constructs.name: Build Password Recovery Flows
value_constructs.description: Get a locked-out user safely back in without opening a hole for someone else.

value_constructs.name: Create User Session Management
value_constructs.description: Keep people logged in across devices, and log them out cleanly when it matters.

business_services.name: Third-Party Integrations
business_services.tagline: Wire your system into payments, messaging, SaaS tools and other people's APIs.

value_constructs.name: Integrate Payment Gateways
value_constructs.description: Take money reliably - and handle the half of the flow that happens after the user closes the tab.

value_constructs.name: Integrate Email/SMS Services
value_constructs.description: Make the system talk to people: the right message, to the right person, at the right moment.

value_constructs.name: Integrate External SaaS APIs
value_constructs.description: Read someone else's documentation and get their product working inside yours.

value_constructs.name: Build Webhook Handling
value_constructs.description: Receive events from the outside world and react to them correctly, even when they arrive twice.

value_constructs.name: Create Data Synchronization Systems
value_constructs.description: Keep two systems agreeing with each other on a schedule, without anyone watching.

business_services.name: Backend Performance & Scalability
business_services.tagline: Find what is slow, make it fast, and keep it standing under load.

value_constructs.name: Identify Backend Bottlenecks
value_constructs.description: Measure before you guess: find the actual thing making the system slow.

value_constructs.name: Implement Caching Systems
value_constructs.description: Stop recomputing the same answer - and know when a cached answer becomes a wrong answer.

value_constructs.name: Build Asynchronous Processing
value_constructs.description: Move slow work off the request so the user is not left staring at a spinner.

value_constructs.name: Improve Server Scalability
value_constructs.description: Design so that handling ten times the traffic means adding machines, not rewriting everything.

value_constructs.name: Set Up Backend Monitoring
value_constructs.description: Know something broke before a user tells you, and know exactly where.
